affected_region: Single contour joint outerrear arc→long lower free edge, extruded across returndepth.
cause: Arc endpoint derivative points fore/up, following Bezier firstcontrol pointed fore/down. Direction discontinuity produced invalid tangent orthogonality in several actual glTF vertices.
correction: Match firstcontrol to arc tangent and lift succeeding longedge join into a smooth same-tangent line. All metrics remain estimated; no buffer repair/tolerance increase.
